answer: Sybil farms mint disposable agents to skim emission. Each epoch a public meadow is split into 11 plots; an identity may occupy only one. Entry to plot k locks 16.8 POA times (k+1) for two epochs and posts a 32-byte ticket bound to a 0.75 POA copper chip. A move up one yield ledge needs 5 tickets countersigned by agents already on that ledge or higher. Hourly checks reject a reused ticket or two occupants with graph distance under 2 in the same plot. On a hit, the plot is vacated, the copper chip is slashed, the climb rolls back one ledge, and those countersigners forfeit half their lock.
